{
  "dataset_name": "bitcoinheist_ransomware",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "log_income",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed income to handle extreme skewness and provide a smoother feature space for linear margins.",
      "value_range": [17.0, 29.0],
      "feature_family": "magnitude_transform",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces the impact of extreme outliers in transaction values, allowing the linear SVM to learn more stable weights.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(income)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed transaction count to compress the wide range of transaction volumes.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "magnitude_transform",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linearizes the relationship between transaction volume and the decision boundary.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(count)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_looped",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed looped transaction count to normalize the distribution of cyclic transaction behaviors.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "magnitude_transform",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a continuous, well-scaled measure of cyclic behavior suitable for linear models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(looped)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_neighbors",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed neighbor count to handle the heavy-tailed distribution of network connectivity.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 7.0],
      "feature_family": "magnitude_transform",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Prevents highly connected nodes from dominating the linear SVM margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(neighbors)"
    },
    {
      "name": "loop_to_count_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of looped transactions to total transactions, clipped to a maximum of 10 for stability.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the relative frequency of cyclic behavior, which is often a strong structural signal independent of total volume.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(looped / np.maximum(count, 1), 0.0, 10.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "weight_per_length",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average weight per unit of transaction length.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 200.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes transaction weight by its path length, providing a density metric useful for linear separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "weight / np.maximum(length, 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_income_per_neighbor",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed ratio of income to the number of neighbors.",
      "value_range": [10.0, 29.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights nodes that receive disproportionately large amounts of income relative to their network degree.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(income / np.maximum(neighbors, 1))"
    },
    {
      "name": "network_density_proxy",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of neighbors to total transaction count, clipped for stability.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Measures the breadth of the network relative to activity volume, providing a structural feature for the SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(neighbors / np.maximum(count, 1), 0.0, 10.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "mid_year_proximity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute normalized distance from the middle of the year (day 182.5).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures potential seasonality or temporal clustering in a continuous format suitable for linear models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(day - 182.5) / 182.5"
    },
    {
      "name": "sqrt_weight",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Square root of the transaction weight to reduce skewness while preserving zero values.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "magnitude_transform",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a milder transformation than log for the weight feature, balancing the distribution for linear margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(weight)"
    },
    {
      "name": "semantic_transaction_complexity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "A semantic assessment of the overall complexity of the transaction pattern, considering the interplay between length, weight, count, and looped values.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a holistic, non-linear interpretation of transaction complexity that a linear SVM cannot easily construct from raw features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "semantic_anomalous_topology_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "An expert-level judgment score evaluating the anomaly level of the network topology based on the relationship between neighbors, income, and cyclic loops.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Injects domain-specific structural anomaly detection into the feature space, enhancing the linear model's ability to separate complex patterns.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
